sample_unit: questions (47 diagnosis/treatment + 35 consultation) plus 600 licensing exam questions

links.outcome: LLM accuracy on dental licensing exam and expert-rated oral health answers
links.effect: Average exam accuracy 61.7% (370.2/600); HuatuoGPT 50.8% below passing; 3C scores did not reach full marks (ChatGPT median 3 of 4).
links.quote: Howere, their outputs carry a risk of errors (since the 3C scoring results do not reach the full marks), so prudent judgment should be exercised when using them.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of five LLMs on simulated dental consultation/diagnosis questions and dental licensing exam questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
